content.short: viem is a TypeScript interface for Ethereum offering low level, stateless primitives with end to end type safety from ABIs.
content.description: viem is a TypeScript library for interacting with Ethereum and EVM chains, built by wevm as a modern alternative to ethers.js and web3.js. It exposes low level stateless primitives rather than stateful client objects, and infers types directly from contract ABIs and EIP-712 typed data so function names, arguments, and return values are checked at compile time instead of failing at runtime. It uses native BigInt rather than shipping a bignumber dependency, keeping bundles small, and works out of the box with Anvil and Hardhat.
